chapters.label: The final, live
chapters.text: Basel, the 2025 Euro final: England against Spain. This is how captain Leah Williamson defends. Spain try to pass to their striker... Williamson steps in and steals it!

chapters.label: Watch her read it
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Leah watches the passer's hips. They turn toward the striker, so she moves early. Her boot gets there first, then a calm pass to Keira Walsh.

chapters.label: Step in first
chapters.text: England won that final on penalties. The secret? Watch the passer's hips, and step in before the ball reaches the striker!
